$schema.description: Relative path or URL to the JSON schema definition file.

specsDir.description: Path to the directory containing feature specifications. Supports tokens {projectRoot} and {skillsRoot}.

scoreMin.description: Minimum conformance score (0-10) required before creating delivery commits.

scoring.description: Configuration for Step 5 LLM-judge conformance scoring (Spec 027).

judgeCommand.description: Optional command that judges conformance and writes the verdict JSON. Supports {promptFile}, {verdictFile}, {diffFile}, {criteriaFile}, {slug}, {targetRoot}. When null, the current agent model instance judges and submits the verdict via 'score submit'.

judgeModel.description: Judge model identifier passed to the judge command or the host agent.

judgeProvider.description: Judge provider identifier passed to the judge command or the host agent.

judgeEffort.description: Judge reasoning-effort hint passed to the judge command or the host agent.

judgeApiEndpoint.description: Judge API endpoint passed to the judge command or the host agent.

judgeCriticity.description: Judge strictness: permissive credits partial attempts, strict requires the demanded behaviour, perfectionist requires complete implementation with verification.

scmCodeReviewEnabled.description: Enable remote pull request review polling loop and automated review comment resolution.

pushDelivery.description: Automatically push the delivery commit and branch to remote origin upon workflow completion.

stateDir.description: Path to the directory storing run session state files. Supports tokens {projectRoot} and {skillsRoot}.

skillsRoot.description: Path to the active skills directory. Supports tokens {projectRoot} and {skillsRoot}.

autoResolveGaps.description: Automatically apply recommended defaults for unhandled grilling gaps when running non-interactively.

securityChecksEnabled.description: Enable pre-commit secrets and credentials leak scanning.

useWorktrees.description: Enable per-task isolated git worktrees for dispatched subagents under .sdw/worktrees/{runId}/.

useFeatureBranches.description: Automatically create and activate an isolated feature branch derived from specification slug.

scmProvider.description: Configured SCM provider for issues, work items, and pull requests. Allowed: none, ado, github.

implementation.description: Configuration for task implementation execution in Step 4.

mode.description: Implementation execution mode: subagent (sequential host-dispatched workers, one task at a time) or command (automated subprocess per task).

command.description: Command to execute when implementation.mode is command.

timeoutMs.description: Execution timeout in milliseconds for command mode.

envAllowlist.description: List of allowed environment variable names.

verification.description: Configuration for build and test gates in Step 4.

buildCommand.description: Command executed for build verification gate.

testCommand.description: Command executed for test verification gate.

requiredBuild.description: Enforce successful build verification before creating delivery commit or PR.

buildCommand.description: Command to execute for build verification.

runAllTests.description: Enforce passing all test suites before creating delivery commit or PR.

testCommand.description: Command to execute for test verification pass.

prePrCommand.description: Optional project-specific shell command to execute before PR preparation (e.g. version bump, lint).

prePrInstructions.description: Optional project-specific instructions or checklist for agents to verify prior to PR submission.

reviewFixCommand.description: Optional command that applies review-thread fixes. When unset, sdw-ship-pr never resolves active threads automatically.

maxPreemptions.description: Maximum concurrent-push adaptation budget for post-PR review convergence before draining rounds.
